description: This Kotlin source file defines a Fragment named SearchFragment used for displaying search results within an Android app. It manages RecyclerViews to show VOD items, EPG programs, and favorites, and integrates with data repositories and adapters to present search results.

classes.name: SearchVodAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying VOD items in search results.

classes.name: SearchEpgAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying EPG programs in search results.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, layout managers, fetches the query, and triggers rendering of search results.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI based on the search query, toggling hint visibility and setting RecyclerView adapters with search results.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SearchFragment with the provided search query.
